# 📋 Publish Checklist

**Everything you need before submitting your app to the SUITE App Store**

---

## Pre-Submission Checklist

### ✅ App Basics
- [ ] App has a clear, descriptive name
- [ ] Short description explains what it does
- [ ] App icon/logo is ready (512x512 PNG)
- [ ] Category selected appropriately

### ✅ Functionality
- [ ] App loads without errors
- [ ] All core features work as expected
- [ ] Tested on multiple devices (iOS/Android)
- [ ] Handles offline gracefully

### ✅ Payments
- [ ] SUITE payments integrated correctly
- [ ] Pricing is reasonable for value provided
- [ ] Payment success/failure handled

### ✅ Content
- [ ] No prohibited content (see Content Policy)
- [ ] No placeholder text or "lorem ipsum"
- [ ] All images/assets are included
- [ ] No broken links

### ✅ Polish
- [ ] Loading states for slow operations
- [ ] Error messages are user-friendly
- [ ] UI is consistent and polished
- [ ] Tested edge cases

---

## Submission Process

1. Run `/publish app:YourAppName` in Discord
2. App enters review queue
3. Community reviewers test your app
4. If approved, goes live in App Store
5. Start earning from transactions!

---

## Review Criteria

Apps are reviewed for:

| Criteria | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| **Functionality** | Does it work as described? |
| **Content** | Follows content guidelines? |
| **Quality** | Polished, no major bugs? |
| **Value** | Provides real utility? |
